_about: Truth for scripts/verify-ai-import-paper-formats.ts. officialKey: transcribed column by column from the original key files in the Original Paper Vault (X = dropped, A/B = both accepted). index: printed number, page and opening words read from the original scanned pages. storedReads: the reading order / page / number of the AI extraction stored for that paper on 2026-10-30 and the source question its text really is (audit 2026-10-31) — numbers only, no question text. The paper files themselves are not committed: set AI_IMPORT_PAPER_FIXTURES to a folder holding them under the names in 'file'. sourceMarks: the answer mark printed in each Word source (read with an independent line rule, not the importer's parser); sourceMarkContradictsKey: numbers where that mark differs from the official key (spot-checked on content: e.g. 2013 Paper II Q15 jugular foramen, Q29 claw sign).
